thread:
mira: FYI: multiple customers escalated — per-model throughput panels in Console are flatlined (showing 0). Customers report backend still serving requests; only the Console per-model lines disappeared. Screenshots attached by CS.

sam: which customers? any common model names or versions?

mira: CS attachments: https://redwood.work/s/attachments/IMG_20260310_console_issue.png

mira: Observed: only dashboards that aggregate by label `model` are empty. Cluster-wide metrics like total QPS are normal.

ops-jen: paste the exact panel PromQL and which exporter version was deployed last night?

mira: Panel query (copied):
```
sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m]))
```

mira: Exporter rollout: model-exporter v2.4.3 -> v2.5.0 at 2026-03-09T03:12Z (automated canary)

jordan: v2.5.0 included a metrics schema change for compliance. New label keys are `model_id` and `variant`. I suspect `model` was removed.

sam: I can curl a running exporter pod. One-liner:
```
curl -s http://10.55.77.12:9100/metrics | grep redwood_inference_requests_total | head
# redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id="rw-13b",variant="q4_0"} 4567
```

sam: Confirmed: `model` label is gone, replaced with `model_id`.

mira: That matches. Dashboards grouped by `model` return no series.

ben: Two paths: revert exporter to previous version (risky), or provide a compatibility shim that mirrors `model_id` -> `model` until dashboards are updated.

ops-jen: Short-term: deploy a lightweight metrics proxy sidecar that rewrites metrics and adds a `model` label when `model_id` exists. Medium-term: update Grafana queries and alerts to support both labels.

jordan: I'll open a small image that rewrites only the relevant metric families. Sidecar behavior: fetch /metrics, inject `model="<value>"` when `model_id` present, expose on :9191.

sam: Also consider updating queries to be label-agnostic using label_replace fallback. Example approach:
```
# prefer model, else fallback to model_id
label_replace(
  label_replace(redwood_inference_requests_total, "model_fallback", "$1", "model", "(.*)"),
  "model_fallback", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)"
)
```
But this is messy; easier to change panels to query `sum by (model_id) (...)` and rename field in Grafana.

mira: CS notified affected customers, gave ETA ~90 minutes for mitigation. We paused related alert rules to avoid noisy paging.

ops-jen: Rolling sidecar to canary exporters now.

ben: Also created a short-lived Prometheus recording rule in canary Prometheus to map model_id->model to assist dashboards while we roll. Note: recording rules can't dynamically copy labels easily, so this is temporary and limited in scope.

jordan: Sidecar deployed to canary, metrics now show both labels. Verified locally:
```
redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id="rw-13b",variant="q4_0",model="rw-13b"} 4567
```

sam: Grafana panels in canary show per-model lines again. CS confirmed one customer saw graphs return.

mira: Incident created: INC-2026-03-10-01 — Priority P2. Assignee: ops-jen.

ops-jen: Plan for next 48h:
1) eng-ml to add a flag to exporter to emit legacy `model` labels for 30 days
2) eng-platform to update Console dashboards to accept both `model` and `model_id` (use `label_replace` or query `by (model_id)`), ship changes in a coordinated deploy
3) infra to maintain the sidecar image and a templated helm value to enable for affected clusters

ben: I'll file GH issues for tracking and own the migration doc: infra/metrics-compat-shim, eng-ml/exporter-legacy-flag, eng-platform/dashboard-migration.

mira: Thanks. We'll keep customers updated and close once all clusters have either shim or dashboards updated. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-03-10-01 — per-model throughput panels restored. Duration: 1h 44m.
